ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between low-intensity (black) epidermal pixels and high-intensity (white) specular reflections and calcified clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark/black intensity across both lobes. High-intensity specular glare regions occupy the upper-medial sector of the left lobe and upper-lateral sector of the right lobe. Discrete high-intensity circular blobs are concentrated at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated acute V-shaped depression approximately 45-55 degrees with a deep bounding-box depth relative to the adjacent trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical topography. Left lobe displays fine-scale, high-frequency serrations. Right lobe displays large-scale macro-indentations, specifically a prominent semi-circular concave void located approximately 75% distance from the notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory originating at the median notch and sweeping upward to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups located on the distal edges and tips of both lobes. Scattered smaller circular clusters are visible across the central pigmentation field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss on the right lobe trailing edge characterized by a large semi-circular indentation/truncation.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy peripheral accumulation of high-intensity circular calcifications (barnacles) localized along the distal leading and trailing margins.
